combat_actions.name: Aim
combat_actions.description: Take extra time to make attacks more precise.

effects.full: +10 To Hit on first two attacks
loss_conditions: Target moves more than Perception Modifier

combat_actions.citation: “Aiming as a Half Action gives the Character a +5 To Hit…”

combat_actions.name: Blind Fire
combat_actions.citation: “When using Blind Fire, shots are made at a -60 Penalty.”

combat_actions.name: Brace Weapon
combat_actions.description: Prepare a Heavy Weapon for firing.
combat_actions.citation: “Bracing is a Half Action needed to use [HW] Heavy Weapons without Penalty.”

combat_actions.name: Called Shot
combat_actions.citation: “Attacking a specific body location gives the Character a -30 Penalty…”

combat_actions.name: Charge
combat_actions.description: Move in a straight line and attack.
combat_actions.citation: “The Charge Attack increases the Pierce… equal to the Meters traveled.”

combat_actions.name: Evade
combat_actions.description: Oppose an attack using the Evasion Skill.
combat_actions.citation: “Test the Evasion Skill opposed against an attack.”

combat_actions.name: Forced Reposition
combat_actions.description: Force an opponent to move via opposed Warfare Melee.
combat_actions.citation: “Attempts to force the opponent a number of meters equal to half their Half Move.”

combat_actions.name: Grapple
combat_actions.citation: “The Character defends or attacks a Grapple Action…”

combat_actions.name: Guarded Attack
combat_actions.citation: “The character suffers a -10 Penalty… but gain a +10 Bonus to all Evasion tests.”

combat_actions.name: Killzone
combat_actions.citation: “A Killzone is a 45-degree cone facing a chosen direction…”

combat_actions.name: Readied Stance
combat_actions.description: Focus entirely on defense; gain two penalty-free Reactions.
combat_actions.citation: “May make two Reactions that gives no Penalties…”

combat_actions.name: Reload
combat_actions.citation: “The length of the Reload Action depends on the Weapon being reloaded…”

combat_actions.name: Standard Attack
combat_actions.citation: “The Active Character makes a Ranged or Melee Attack…”

combat_actions.name: Suppressing Fire
combat_actions.description: Force opponents to stay in cover.
combat_actions.citation: “Suppressing Fire is where a Character… fires wildly at an Opponent…”

combat_actions.name: Tactical Advance
combat_actions.citation: “The Active Character moves from one point of cover to the next.”

combat_actions.name: Throwing Objects
combat_actions.description: Throw grenades, improvised weapons, or other objects.
combat_actions.citation: “As a Half Action, the Character will throw an object…”
